metadata.description: Agent tooling for the Apeiron Engine

plugins.name: apeiron
plugins.description: Drive the Apeiron Engine editor from Claude Code: the engine's agent skills, an MCP server that starts the editor for your project on the first call, slash commands, verification agents and a session hook that says which editor belongs to this folder.

plugins.name: apeiron-web
plugins.description: Drive the Apeiron Engine web editor (engine.apeironengine.com) from Claude Code: the same agent skills, recipes and agents as the apeiron plugin, with the hosted relay as its MCP server. Sign in once with /mcp and every browser tab signed into your Apeiron account is reachable.
